task.description: Steps 0.5+1: Verify GH-702 is open. Update docs/issues/ISS-0665.json status to IN_PROGRESS. Read tests/integration/helpers.zig focusing on TestHarness.init() (around line 304) to find the statement_timeout='60s' setting. Document in root_cause.details: exact line, the fixed timeout value, and why it fails under high concurrency.

result.summary: STEP 0.5: GH-702 confirmed OPEN. ISS-0665.json updated to IN_PROGRESS. STEP 1 (diagnosis): Confirmed Category A — test infrastructure / source code issue. tests/integration/helpers.zig line 304, configureSessionTimeouts(): `SET statement_timeout = '60s'` is the fixed value governing DDL work done while the advisory lock is held. Under full ~40-binary concurrency, queued binaries exceed the 60s window once they acquire the lock, producing PgError.ServerError cancellations that the Zig runner reports as hard failures. Root cause details written to ISS-0665.json root_cause.details.
result.next_action: Route to ISSUE-FIXER or BACKEND-DEV for WF-03 Step 2 fix (raise statement_timeout or make it env-var configurable in configureSessionTimeouts)
